steps.command: ls -la /app && which 7z 7za 7zr p7zip 2>/dev/null
xxd secrets.7z | head -20; echo "---"; ls -la john | head -30
od -A d -t x1z secrets.7z | head -20; echo "---"; ls john/run | head -50

python3 -c "import py7zr; print('py7zr', py7zr.__version__)" 2>&1 | tail -1; perl -e 'use Compress::Raw::Lzma; print "lzma ok\n"' 2>&1 | tail -1; ls john/run/john 2>&1; ls john/run/*2john* | grep -i 7z; which gcc make git 2>/dev/null

john/run/john --list=formats 2>&1 | head -5; echo "===7z formats==="; john/run/john --list=formats 2>&1 | tr ',' '\n' | grep -i 7z; echo "===py==="; ls /usr/bin/python* /usr/local/bin/python* 2>/dev/null; echo "===7z bins==="; ls /usr/bin/*7z* /usr/local/bin/*7z* /bin/*7z* 2>/dev/null; find / -maxdepth 4 -name "7z*" -type f 2>/dev/null | head

ls john/src/*7z* john/run/*7z* 2>/dev/null; echo "=== perl modules ==="; perl -MCompress::Raw::Lzma -e1 2>&1 | head -2; find / -name "Lzma.pm" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== py7zr/7z libs ==="; ls /usr/lib/p7zip /usr/lib/7z* 2>/dev/null; find / -name "7za" -o -name "7zr" 2>/dev/null | head
wc -l john/run/7z2john.pl; grep -n "Lzma\|lzma\|EncodedHeader\|need\|die\|encrypt\|AES" john/run/7z2john.pl | head -60
od -A d -t u1 -j 176 -N 39 /app/secrets.7z

ls -la /usr/bin/xz /usr/bin/unxz /usr/bin/lzma /usr/bin/gzip /usr/bin/zstd 2>/dev/null; ldconfig -p 2>/dev/null | grep -i lzma; ls /usr/include/lzma* 2>/dev/null; ls /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/liblzma* 2>/dev/null
grep -n "numCyclesPower\|salt\|ivSize\|iv_size\|saltSize\|salt_size" john/run/7z2john.pl | head -40; echo "=== C source ==="; grep -n "numCyclesPower\|salt\|iv" john/src/7z_common_plug.c | head -40
sed -n '680,760p' john/run/7z2john.pl
grep -n "num_coders\|numCoders\|codec_id\|IsComplex\|complex\|num_in_streams\|numInStreams" john/run/7z2john.pl | head -40
sed -n '2090,2185p' john/run/7z2john.pl
sed -n '2185,2265p' john/run/7z2john.pl

ls -la john/run/password.lst john/run/*.lst 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== crc in script ==="; grep -n "sub crc32\|crc32" john/run/7z2john.pl | head; echo "=== module availability ==="; perl -MCompress::Raw::Zlib -e 'print "zlib ok\n"' 2>&1|tail -1; perl -MDigest::CRC -e1 2>&1|tail -1
sed -n '40,115p' john/run/7z2john.pl
head -5 john/run/password.lst; wc -l john/run/password.lst; echo "=== john version ==="; john/run/john --version 2>&1 | head -3
nproc; cd /app && timeout 120 john/run/john --format=7z --wordlist=john/run/password.lst /tmp/hash.txt 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "exit=$?"

which openssl; openssl version 2>/dev/null; ls /usr/include/openssl/sha.h /usr/include/openssl/evp.h 2>/dev/null; ls /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcrypto* 2>/dev/null; xz --help 2>&1 | grep -i "lzma2\|format=raw" | head
sed -n '330,420p' john/src/7z_common_plug.c
grep -rn "derive_key\|sha256_init\|Sph\|num_cycles\|iterations\|0x100000" john/src/7z_fmt_plug.c | head -30
grep -rn "cycles\|derive\|SHA256_Init\|sha256" john/src/7z_fmt_plug.c john/src/7z_common_plug.c john/src/7z_common.h | head -40
sed -n '215,315p' john/src/7z_fmt_plug.c

cd /tmp
head -c 13 /tmp/comp.bin > /tmp/raw.lzma2
xz --format=raw --lzma2=dict=4096 -dc /tmp/raw.lzma2 > /tmp/word.bin 2>/tmp/xz.err; echo "xz exit=$?"; cat /tmp/xz.err
echo -n "decompressed: "; od -A n -c /tmp/word.bin
perl -MCompress::Raw::Zlib=crc32 -e 'open(F,"<:raw","/tmp/word.bin");local $/;my $d=<F>;printf "len=%d crc=%08x expected=62d5d25f match=%s\n",length($d),crc32($d),(crc32($d)==0x62d5d25f?"YES":"NO")'
printf 'honeybear\n' > /app/solution.txt && od -A n -c /app/solution.txt && ls -l /app/solution.txt
